errors.mobileAction: Discard the scanned value or invalid challenge and restart pairing.
Do not retry the token. Request and scan a new pairing QR.
Discard the pairing state and scan a newly issued QR.
Stop pairing and ask an authorized manager to correct the Staff assignment.
Do not blindly replay. Verify IDs, exact envelope bytes, key selection, and base64url encoding.
Prompt for automatic device time, then retry with a fresh request ID, timestamp, nonce, and signature.
Fix exact-byte serialization; regenerate digest, envelope, and signature before retrying.
Generate a fresh request ID, nonce, timestamp, digest, and signature. Preserve only any operation idempotency UUID.
Treat the session as unusable. Clear it atomically and require pairing again unless a single in-flight refresh can still succeed.
Correct the request from error.details.fields; do not retry unchanged.
Back off and retry later with newly generated signing values when signing is required.
Use HTTP status and request ID as fallback; do not assume the request is retryable.
Show a safe localized error and use bounded backoff. Never replay an old signed envelope.
